text:
Sam (CS): putting together a very short go-live quickplay for customers: caching, batching, streaming. need a tiny checklist + a copyable config and 2 renewal-risk signals.

Ria (SE): Checklist bullets: 1) run top-5 prompts as smoke, 2) enable prefill with ttl 900s for bursty apps, 3) set initial_batch_size:4 and max:12.

Ria (SE): config snippet customers can paste:
```
prefill: true
prefill_ttl_seconds: 900
batching:
  initial_batch_size: 4
  max_batch_size: 12
  jitter_ms: 25
streaming:
  enable_streaming: true
  partial_retry_limit: 1
```

Jon (Product): renewal-risk signals to auto-flag: drop in cache_hit_rate > 30% over 24h, or p95_latency > SLA + 200ms for >1h. both trigger CS outreach + SE pairing.

Sam (CS): feedback capture schedule: quick survey at day0, day3, day14 with 3 q's (latency ok? errors? critical prompts?). attach results to account notes.

DocBot: Saved template: "CS quickplay: warmup + config" (drive).

Sam (CS): action items: I'll draft 1-pager + 2-slide summary (EOD). Ria, please add YAML to onboarding repo (24h). Jon, please confirm the alert thresholds (tomorrow).
